Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.quote: Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon. Sharma ji ne aapka number diya tha, painting ke liye.

Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.text: Sunita says the job is to paint her entire 2BHK flat in Indirapuram, including both bedrooms, the hall, the kitchen, and the balcony grill.
Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.value: painting the full 2BHK flat, including bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and balcony grill
Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.quote: Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Poora flat paint karwana hai - dono bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur balcony ki grill bhi.

Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.text: Ramesh asks whether the ceiling should also be painted or only the walls.
Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.quote: Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya sirf walls?

Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.text: Sunita says the work also includes the ceiling.
Sunita says one bedroom also has dampness and needs putty there.
Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.value: putty in one bedroom for dampness
Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.quote: Aur ek bedroom mein thodi seelan hai, wahan putty bhi lagegi.

Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.text: The worker says the damp wall will get putty and primer first, then two coats.
Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.value: putty and primer first, then two coats
Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.quote: Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe pehle putty aur primer, phir do coat.

Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.quote: Paint kaunsa lagwana hai, normal emulsion ya premium wala?

Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.text: Sunita says the paint should be normal emulsion.
Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.quote: Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emulsion theek hai. Material aap laoge ya main mangwaun?

Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.text: The worker says he will bring the material himself.
Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.quote: Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tension nahi leni.

Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.text: The worker says he will quote the total after including labour and material.
Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.quote: Labour aur material mila ke bata deta hoon.

Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?.text: The hirer asks what the total cost will be.
Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?.quote: Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?

Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam b.text: Ramesh says the total for labour and material together will be 28,000 rupees.
Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam b.quote: Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam bhi hai... labour material sab mila ke 28 hazaar lagega.

Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.text: The hirer says 28,000 rupees is too much.
The hirer says the whole house was done for 20,000 rupees last time.
Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.quote: Pichhli baar 20 mein poora ghar hua tha.

Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Ch.text: The worker says the total can be reduced to 25,000 rupees, but not lower.
Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Ch.quote: Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Chaliye aapke liye 25 kar deta hoon, isse kam nahi hoga.

24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.text: Sunita proposes 24,000 rupees as the final total.
24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.quote: 24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahiye.

The worker says the 24,000 rupees includes labour, material, and putty.

Done. Aur advance kitna chahiye aapko?.text: Sunita accepts the 24,000 rupees total by saying 'Done.'

Material lana padega na madam, to 8 haza.text: The worker says that because material has to be brought, he wants 8,000 rupees as advance before starting the work.
Material lana padega na madam, to 8 haza.quote: Material lana padega na madam, to 8 hazaar advance de dijiye, kaam shuru karne se pehle.

8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.text: Sunita accepts the 8,000 rupees advance and says she will GPay it on the morning the work starts.
8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.quote: 8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shuru karoge us din subah GPay kar dungi.

8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.text: Sunita says she will pay the advance on the morning of the day the work starts.
8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.value: morning of the day work starts
8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.quote: 8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shuru karoge us din subah GPay kar dungi.

Aur khatam kab tak hoga?.text: The hirer asks when the work will be finished.

Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.quote: Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru, Friday shaam tak poora finish.

Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.text: The worker says the work starts Monday.
Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.quote: Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru, Friday shaam tak poora finish.

Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.text: The worker says the work will be finished by Friday evening.
Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.quote: Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru, Friday shaam tak poora finish.

Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jay.text: The hirer says the finish day is Friday, not later.

Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.text: The hirer accepts the late-work penalty of 500 rupees per day.
Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.quote: Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakhna.

Ji madam, zubaan di hai..text: The worker says he has given his word.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko m.text: The hirer says they will meet on Monday.
